headline: Argentina Seeks Multilateral Guarantees to Secure 2026-2027 Financing
summary: Argentina's economic team is negotiating multilateral-guaranteed credit lines to complete external financing for 2026 and 2027, following market questions over the suspension of the Bonar 2029 bond.
why: Access to multilateral lending and guarantees is critical for Argentina to meet foreign currency debt obligations without market access.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Securing multilateral-backed credit would cover sovereign external financing needs for 2026 and 2027.
